name: The Shops at North East Mall
summary: The Shops at North East Mall is a regional shopping center in Hurst, Texas, serving the northeast Dallas-Fort Worth area. Operating daily from 10 AM to 9 PM, this established mall provides a traditional enclosed shopping experience for the Mid-Cities community.
demographics: The Shops at North East Mall primarily serves middle-income families and young professionals in the northeast Tarrant County area, including Hurst, Bedford, Euless, and North Richland Hills. The trade area consists of diverse suburban households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $80,000, including a mix of young families with children, working professionals, and retirees. Shoppers typically seek value-oriented retail options and convenient access to everyday shopping needs, with strong representation from the 25-54 age demographic that values both national chain retailers and practical amenities.
description: The Shops at North East Mall is a prominent shopping destination located in Hurst, Texas, serving the northeast Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Situated at 852 Northeast Mall Boulevard, this regional mall has been a cornerstone of retail activity in the Mid-Cities area, offering shoppers a convenient and comprehensive shopping experience. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing ample time for visitors to explore its diverse tenant mix. With a solid 3.9-star rating, the mall continues to attract both local residents and visitors from surrounding communities seeking a traditional enclosed mall shopping experience. The Shops at North East Mall represents a classic regional shopping center that has adapted to serve the evolving needs of the Hurst community and greater Tarrant County area.
